summary: Zenta Group Company Limited, a Cayman Islands exempted company listed as a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, responding to unusual market activity through August 6, 2026. The company stated it is not aware of any material nonpublic information that would account for recent trading. No transactions, terms, advisors, or recommendations were disclosed. The filing is a routine market comment, not a special-situation event. What to watch: whether further disclosures or regulatory probes follow if unusual trading persists.
